EmptyDesk.SolvedText: The Records Office. The originals never leave it, and it's locked after hours.

Insights.Text: The register was copied from an original, and the original went back to the Records Office the day she vanished.
Her desk and the register say the same thing: someone is erasing Mira Holt, and she knew it was coming.
Whoever wrote the note knew exactly where to look. Mira wasn't the only one who noticed.
